title: Mephedrone/Synthesis

plain_text:
Materials

Equipment

• This synthesis requires no labware.

• You will need a 1 liter glass flask bottle with a screwcap.

Proportions required for 1L Flask

1. 2b4mp* (2-Bromo-4-methylpropiophenone) - 100g​

2. Benzene - 200ml​

3. Methylamine 40% (aqueous solution) - 140ml​

4. Hydrochloric acid - 40ml​

5. Acetone - 600ml

Synthesis

Step 1: Synthesis

Take 200ml of benzene and pour it into a bottle. Carefully add 100g 2b4mp. Shake the bottle until 2b4mp dissolves completely. Then add 140ml of 40% aqueous methylamine solution. Place a cellophane sheet under the lid and close tightly. Create an airtight seal inside the bottle by wrapping the neck with tape. Allow the mixture to stand for 24 hours with periodic stirring.

If you place the bottle in water at 40-50 degrees and stir more vigorously, the synthesis time is reduced to 3-4 hours.

Step 2: Free base flushing

Important: Wear gloves throughout the process.
When the time is up, pour the contents of the bottle into a 2 liter plastic bottle and pour 1 liter of 30-40ºC water into the same bottle. Close the lid and stir well for a few minutes. Then wait for a clear separation of the fractions, which takes 15-20 minutes. There will be a free base of 4-MMC in benzene (oil) at the top, water at the bottom. We need the top layer. The bottom layer needs to be drained. To do this, turn the bottle upside down and open the lid slightly. So that the contents of the bottle are slowly poured out. When only the top layer remains in the bottle, you must stop draining.
Then, pour another liter of warm water into the bottle and repeat the process of rinsing the oil out of the bottle. And again drain the aqueous fraction into the trash. In the end, after all the manipulations, you should have only yellow oil in the bottle (free base 4-MMC in benzene).

Step 3: Acidification

For acidification, the contents of the bottle can be poured into a wide-necked liter jar, or the bottle itself can be carefully cut in half. Hydrochloric acid and acetone, mixed in a ratio of 1 to 10, are used for acidification. For 100 grams of 2b4mp, you will typically need 30-40 ml of hydrochloric acid and 300-400 ml of high quality dry acetone. It is better to prepare an acid solution immediately before starting acidification. The acidification is carried out in small portions and the mixture is stirred constantly. For mixing it is convenient to use a thin long 1ml syringe or a syringe plunger.

As the acid solution is added, a slurry precipitate will form and the mixture will self-heat. If the mixture gets too thick, you can dilute it with 50-100 ml of acetone (more is possible). The mixture should not be too thick, otherwise it will be difficult to filter it out.
Once acidification is complete, the mixture should be cooled and stored in the freezer for 4-6 hours.
Do not forget to put a lid on the jar.

When acidifying it is desirable to fix the pH of the mixture with indicators, when the pH=5 is reached, stop the acidification.

Step 4: Filtration

After freezing you get a mushy mixture. Filter this substance through a paper filter or a thick napkin or cloth. Dry in the air cut into pieces.
Mephedrone should be white with a slight tint, with a faint odor and a bitter taste. If the mephedrone obtained has a pungent smell, a sour or salty taste, or a color very different from white, it should be washed. When it is completely dry, grind the mephedrone into a fine powder. Add a small amount of ice-cold (from the freezer), high-quality dry acetone so that the mixture is liquid. Then filter and dry again. Rinse the mephedrone until it looks good and clean.

From 100g of 2b4mp the average yield is ~50g of mephedrone flour. Which can be crystallized.

Step 5: Crystallization

Dissolve 50g of pure mephedrone powder in 100ml of water (or 50/50 alcohol water or vodka). Heat until bubbling and allow to crystallize in a bowl. You will get mephedrone crystals after the solvent evaporates.
